device_entry.description: 一个非物理的软件扫描组件，用于实验中的连续运动（slew）扫描流程控制。它负责准备扫描、检查光束状态、协调轨迹运动与探测器触发/等待，并将主文件、MCS、环境数据及额外探测器数据写入保存。
device_entry.description_en: A non-physical software scan component used to control continuous-motion (slew) scan workflows in experiments. It prepares scans, checks beam status, coordinates trajectory motion and detector arming/waiting, and saves master, MCS, environmental, and extra detector data.
